name: Apple Card

sources.label: Apple Support: Apply for Apple Card

reviewNotes: Apple Card is issued by Goldman Sachs Bank USA and has no annual fee. It has no recurring trackable credits under the Catalog rules: Daily Cash is uncapped purchase-based earning, while Apple Card Monthly Installments and payment tools are financing or account features. A local image is intentionally deferred because Apple's current standalone official card photo is a front/back composite containing a sample cardholder name, so imageUrl is null rather than referencing an absent or unsuitable asset. Global synchronization disposition: create one new card definition and no benefit definitions. Existing-card status propagation and Benefit Usage Guide linkage are not applicable because this card has no catalog benefits. No database synchronization or materialization is part of this proposal.
